title: Verify: Opening dialogue progression unit tests
description: Test dialogue progression through the real bedroom.yaml.
technical_constraints: Use real scene from runtime/content, no mocks of systems

steps.action: Build state with createInitialState(world, scene). Assert getActiveNode text equals "I don't know what to do next. What should we do?" and choices texts equal ['Look around the room', "Let's explore"]. chooseOption index 0: activeDialogue 'look-around', flags.looked_around true. Index 1 on a fresh state: 'explore', flags.exploring true. Choosing 0 on the follow-up node sets activeDialogue null.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/dialogueProgression.test.ts
